So, this is my family. My father is a music teacher and my mother works in a hospital. I am not an only child: I have one sister and one stepbrother. My stepbrother is called Danny, and he is nineteen. People say we look like brothers, and we get along really well now, but at first it was strange. My sister Kate and I are twins. We were born on the same day, but our faces are completely different. My grandparents live in the same street as us, so I see them every week. Their house is small but very warm. And my aunt Laura and my uncle Steve have three kids, so my cousins are always at our house on Sunday. Our family is big and noisy, and I miss them a lot.

My family is smaller than Ryan's family. I am an only child, so I do not have a brother or a sister. My mother is a nurse and my father works with computers. People say I look like my mother, but my personality is my father's. My grandparents live in another neighborhood, and I visit them on Saturday, after the market. My aunt Cristina is my mother's sister, and she has two children. My cousins are eight and eleven years old, and they call me every week. My uncle Paulo tells terrible jokes, but we all laugh anyway. We do not see each other every day, but we get along very well, and our house is always open.

First, you say how big your family is and you say, my family is small. Next, you present your parents and you say, my mother is a nurse and my father works with computers. After that, you talk about brothers and sisters and you say, I am an only child. Then, you present the other relatives and you say, my aunt has two children, so I have two cousins. Finally, you say how you feel about them and you say, we get along very well.
